item.title: Seattle home listings jump again as prices soften statewide
item.description: A new report shows active home listings rose sharply across WA while prices declined for the third straight month compared to a year ago, a sign the market is loosening and demand remains cautious.

item.title: USPS policy change means WA ballots may need manual postmark stamp
item.description: Washington officials warn the new USPS change could affect time-sensitive mail like ballots, tax forms, and legal documents if they’re mailed close to deadlines.

item.title: Driver traveling 156 mph on I-5 near SeaTac, WA, outruns troopers
item.description: The Washington State Patrol (WSP) shared video of a car traveling 156 mph with its lights off in foggy conditions in the SeaTac area on New Year's Eve.

item.title: WA lawmaker proposes new rules for license plate reading cameras
item.description: A Washington bill would limit how data from license plate reading cameras is used and shared, ban access for immigration enforcement, and require most data to be deleted within hours or days.

item.title: Seahawks Notebook: Charles Cross, Elijah Arroyo return to practice
item.description: Tight end Elijah Arroyo was designated to return from injured reserve, and left tackle Charles Cross returned to practice after missing the last three games with a hamstring injury for the Seahawks.

item.title: Crooks target mom and son owned Seattle trading card shop
item.description: Surveillance video captured a crook breaking into a family-owned business in West Seattle, causing thousands of dollars in loss and damages.

item.title: Suspect arrested in murder of Bothell woman found in Mason County, WA
item.description: An arrest has been made in the murder of 27-year-old Mallory Barbour, a Bothell woman whose body was found in the woods in Mason County on Sep. 15.

item.title: Hannah Bilka scores lone goal in Seattle Torrent's 2-1 loss to Fleet
item.description: Jamie Lee Rattray and Megan Keller each scored for the Boston Fleet in a 2-1 win over the Seattle Torrent on Wednesday night.

item.title: Seattle weather: Heavy mountain snow, scattered showers Thursday
item.description: The Winter Storm Warning remains in effect for the cascades through 4 p.m. Thursday for continued heavy snow.

item.title: Around 200 protest fatal ICE shooting in front of Seattle's federal building
item.description: About 200 people gathered outside Seattle’s Federal Building for an emergency protest after a fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis.
